messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On behalf of many developers (see
https://ambermd.org/contributors.html
), I am
pleased to announce the release of AmberTools20 and Amber20.  These are
significant updates from previous versions.
For information about new features, downloading and installation, please
visit:
https://ambermd.org
The updated reference manual can be viewed here:
https://ambermd.org/doc12/Amber20.pdf
A note to those who have used previous versions: the build procedure has
changed, so be sure to consult Chapter 2 in the new Reference Manual.
Thanks to everyone who helped make this possible.
....dave case
